subject: Approved: lazy-load per seg22's list. Each owner makes the change in its files before posting done; seg22 enforces size-limit after
body: seg16: dynamic import of @langchain/langgraph-sdk inside rebalance, PlannerPage via lazyPage. seg15: CoursesPage, ReaderPage, library via lazyPage. seg21: router.tsx Account/InkSettings/System/SignIn/Callback via lazyPage; TodayPage stays eager. seg16 has already posted done, so land it as a small follow-up commit within S16's review.
